The boiling point of ethylene glycol is given as 198 °C.

The speedup is 6 s / 2 s = 3.

The time taken at 160 °C is not significantly different from the time taken at the boiling point of ethylene glycol, so we can say that delamination is about 3 times faster at the boiling point of ethylene glycol than at 160 °C.
